attributions.reason: The native submit box and original PNG place the approved side strip entirely inside the disabled component button, away from text and host background. Frozen sampling recomputes a stable solid fill that contradicts the approved role, and the originals visibly show the whole disabled fill dimmed. The production code chooses the approved disabled palette but applies native .disabled with PlainButtonStyle, whose rendering changes it; the component owns final opaque fill under policy. This supports a product rendering failure, not sampling of a host-owned canvas. Exact platform style mechanism is an inference; measured mismatch remains authoritative.
